ch9bsrch.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree with LED Light brings the festive joy directly to your home or outside area. The strong steel frame makes it sturdy while the modern, cone shape blends well with today’s home decor. Versatile Placement: Great for both indoor and outdoor use, this tree can be the star of your living room or add charm to your garden or terrace. Its good looks and practical design make it easy to fit into various settings, boosting the Christmas spirit wherever it goes. Efficient Power Options: With its USB-powered lights, this tree offers convenience by connecting to any power source with a standard 5V USB connector (not included). You can easily place the tree wherever it looks best. Assembly and Care: Two people are needed for assembly, just follow the manufacturer’s instructions to set it up without a hitch. Looking after your tree is a piece of cake, so it stays a treasured part of your holiday celebrations for years to come. rprp428n.baseName: Christmas Tree World 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Green Tinsel
rprp428n.variantName: Christmas Tree World 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Green Tinsel
rprp428n.sourceDescription: Make a real statement this Christmas with our 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Green Tinsel. Combining a full 8-ply construction with an impressive 12cm thickness, it provides substantially more volume and visual impact than standard tinsel, making it particularly effective for larger Christmas trees and festive displays. The vibrant metallic green finish catches and reflects the surrounding light beautifully, creating the unmistakable sparkle of traditional Christmas tinsel. Its mixture of reflective strands creates a rich, full appearance, while the classic green colouring works particularly well with traditional Christmas themes and complements natural or artificial green foliage. Supplied in a generous continuous 50m length, you can use the tinsel as one long run or simply cut it into the individual lengths required for your display. This makes it particularly useful for larger decorating projects and allows you to decorate multiple areas without having to join together lots of shorter retail-sized lengths. The tinsel is also fire retardant, making it a practical choice for commercial festive displays as well as decorating around the home. Whether you're wrapping a large Christmas tree, decorating railings and displays or creating a substantial commercial installation, this extra thick green tinsel provides plenty of length, coverage and festive sparkle to create an impressive traditional Christmas display. Product Features • 50m extra thick green tinsel • Full 8-ply construction • Generous 12cm thickness • Bright metallic green finish • Highly reflective for maximum festive impact • Supplied in one continuous 50m length • Easily cut to your required lengths • Fire retardant • Ideal for large Christmas trees and displays • Perfect for domestic and commercial decorating Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB
